inbox.text: Any elementary course gives at least false confidence. But boxing is definitely quicker to learn than BJJ. Grappling (Judo, wrestling, BJJ etc.) needs more ability to read the opponent and nobody is anywhere near a good grappler in the beginning. One hundred boxing classes will definitely make you a good boxer against someone who doesn’t train. I’ve taken some 400 of grappling classes and I start feeling like I could win a fight against someone that has no significant physical advantage.
